summary: At zero-based step 364 the elapsed-turn preflight refuses a due BURN_OBJECT timer because timeout_funcs has no burn_object handler. source.branch: An applied, carried tallow candle has a TIMER_OBJECT/BURN_OBJECT timer due on the current move with age=75, the fuel left at this threshold. The live timer queue must unlink the due element and decrement obj.timed before calling burn_object, which prints the shortening warning and schedules the next burn segment through begin_burn(obj, TRUE).
